page.overview:
Who is Natalya Arat Corrino?

Empress Natalya Arat Corrino was a formidable royal who united thousands of worlds in her marriage to Emperor Javicco Corrino.

A formidable royal who united thousands of worlds through her marriage to Emperor Javicco Corrino, Empress Natalya wishes to make her own contribution to the young Imperium.

Natalya helped her daughter, Ynez, get dressed for her engagement party. She was betrothed to Pruwet Richese, who was only nine years old. Natalya didn't approve of the union and told Ynez she wanted her to be able to rule how she wanted and marry how she wanted. Ynez insisted to her mother that she was happy with the arrangement as she could live the next several years until he came of age how she wanted.

Natalya then went to her husband, who said he didn't feel like he had any choice but to move forward with their wedding. Their own marriage was arranged, but Natalya had been the one to broker it herself. But she knew things were different with Ynez and Pruwet. Javicco said that the marriage came with resources they needed, so it needed to go forward.
